description.html: The first of its kind, the CeramiClad™ Frying Pan combines the even and responsive heat control of our Award Winning 5-Ply Stainless Clad Cookware with a proprietary Non Stick ceramic coating. Simple to use and just as simple to maintain, our American-Made ceramic coating is made without PFAS, PFOA, PTFE, lead, and cadmium, making for a clean staple that'll last longer than lower-cost counterparts. Designed for everyday cooking, our multi-purpose CeramiClad™ Frying Pans are compatible with electric, gas, and induction cooktops. With solid-but-light construction, and wall curvature, they’re workhorses for everything from sautéed vegetables to crisp-skinned seared fish, over-easy fried eggs, stacks of pancakes, and beyond. Unlike cheaper alternatives, they’re safe up to 550 degrees and feature a Stay Cool Handle™—ideal for dishes that start on the stove and get finished in the oven.

Meet a true kitchen workhorse. Crafted in Italy and the USA from 5 layers of metal, the Stainless Clad Frying Pan delivers a durable, easy-to-clean cooking surface with superior heat conduction and distribution. This 5-ply construction means far more searing and flavor-building, and far fewer hot spots and burnt-on messes. The Frying Pan yields crusty butter-basted steaks, pan sauces that come together faster, and crispier, lacier edges on perfectly fried eggs. The curvature of the walls is calculated for deeper searing and easier flipping, while a rolled rim allows you to pour sauces without spilling. The hollow build of our proprietary Stay Cool Handle™ dissipates heat to keep it from getting scalding hot while on the stovetop. This means the heat stays on your ingredients, not your hands. Discover the difference that over-engineered cookware makes in your most-loved meals.

Crafted in Italy, we coat each piece of our Award-Winning 5-Ply Stainless Clad Cookware with multiple layers of professional-grade, FDA-approved Non Stick. The result is an even-heating stainless base with a frictionless cooking surface that is durable enough for high-volume restaurant kitchens, and is the easiest to clean. The combination of the Non Stick coating with the heat control of our Frying Pan makes this pan ideal for cooking almost anything, from French omelettes to oil-free stir-frys. A flared lip and long, ergonomic handle makes for comfortable and easy flipping. Plus, our hollow Stay Cool Handle™ and oven-safe coating up to 500F means you can oven-finish dishes. Discover the difference our chef-loved Non Stick Frying Pan will make in your kitchen.

Get the professional performance of Stainless Clad in every size. Our Stainless Clad Frying Pan put us on the map and with this bundle, you get all three of our Award-Winning Frying Pans. Each Frying Pan is crafted from five layers of premium metals for optimized heat distribution and conduction. The long, Stay Cool Handle and relative light weight lets you move the pan around with ease. The 8” is perfect for searing a filet mignon or frying up a morning egg. If you’re cooking for two, the 10” pan can be used for several portions of vegetables or two chicken breasts. Finally, our large 12” Frying Pan allows you to cook a whole pack of bacon without trimming the strips or baking a Dutch Baby. Discover why this pan is beloved in professional kitchens nationwide.

Pre-seasoned with a mixture of shea nut oil and coconut oil, we’ve taken care of the first two seasonings (the hardest ones) so you can experience the difference Carbon Steel makes on day one. Our Carbon Steel combines the heat retention of cast iron with the control and maneuverability of Stainless Clad, resulting in a natural non stick alternative. We stamp Carbon Steel into a thin disc that’s half the weight of cast iron but every bit as durable—so it seasons faster, responds quicker, and is rugged enough for your grill or open flame. With sloping walls and a wide surface, this pan provides maximum heat contact for high-heat searing. The hollow build of our proprietary Stay Cool Handle™ dissipates heat to keep it from getting scalding hot while on the stovetop. This means the heat stays on your ingredients, not your hands. See how this chef-loved pan will replace cast iron as your favorite kitchen heirloom.

description.html: The first of its kind, the CeramiClad™ Frying Pan combines the even and responsive heat control of our Award Winning 5-Ply Stainless Clad Cookware with a proprietary Non Stick ceramic coating. Simple to use and just as simple to maintain, our American-Made ceramic coating is made without PFAS, PFOA, PTFE, lead, and cadmium, making for a clean staple that'll last longer than lower-cost counterparts. Designed for everyday cooking, our multi-purpose CeramiClad™ Frying Pans are compatible with electric, gas, and induction cooktops. With solid-but-light construction, and wall curvature, they’re workhorses for everything from sautéed vegetables to crisp-skinned seared fish, over-easy fried eggs, stacks of pancakes, and beyond. Unlike cheaper alternatives, they’re safe up to 550 degrees and feature a Stay Cool Handle™—ideal for dishes that start on the stove and get finished in the oven.

description.html: Pre-seasoned with a mixture of shea nut oil and coconut oil, we’ve taken care of the first two seasonings (the hardest ones) so you can experience the difference Carbon Steel makes on day one. Combining the light weight maneuverability and control of Stainless Clad with the heat retention of cast iron, it’s no wonder that Carbon Steel is a favorite in both home and restaurant kitchens worldwide. The hollow build of our proprietary Stay Cool Handle™ dissipates heat to keep it from getting scalding hot while on the stovetop. This means the heat stays on your ingredients, not your hands. Our medium 10” is great for chicken breasts for two or for reheating leftovers. Our largest 12” Frying Pan is ideal for searing proteins like steak or pork chops to create a golden brown crust. Carbon Steel may just become your new go-to material.

products.title: ProCoat Non Stick Frying Pan Set

description.html: Crafted in the United States, we coat each piece of our Award-Winning 5-Ply Stainless Clad Cookware with multiple layers of professional-grade, FDA-approved Non Stick. The result is an even-heating stainless base with a frictionless cooking surface that is durable enough for high-volume restaurant kitchens, and is the easiest to clean. The combination of the Non Stick coating with the heat control of our Frying Pan makes this pan ideal for cooking almost anything, from French omelettes to oil-free stir-frys. A flared lip and long, ergonomic handle makes for comfortable and easy flipping. Plus, our hollow Stay Cool Handle™ and oven-safe coating up to 500F means you can oven-finish dishes. Discover the difference our chef-loved Non Stick Frying Pan will make in your kitchen.

Our Carbon Steel combines the heat retention of cast iron with the control and maneuverability of Stainless Clad, resulting in a natural non stick alternative. We stamp Carbon Steel into a thin disc that’s half the weight of cast iron but every bit as durable—so it seasons faster, responds quicker, and is rugged enough for your grill or open flame. With sloping walls and a wide surface, this pan provides maximum heat contact for high-heat searing. See how this chef-loved pan will replace cast iron as your favorite kitchen heirloom.

A combination of the best qualities of Stainless Clad and cast iron, our Carbon Steel is engineered to perform at extreme temperatures—making it the perfect material for your grill or campfire. With 53 dime-sized perforations designed to maximize direct flame to food contact, the Grill frying Pan infuses rich, smoky flavor into any ingredient. Plus, it's optimized for ingredients big and small—so you’ll never lose another shrimp to the grill grates. We stamp Carbon Steel into a thin disc that’s half the weight of cast iron but every bit as durable. It seasons faster, responds quicker, and is rugged enough for an open flame. This means crispier-skinned chicken wings, flame-kissed vegetables, and evenly charred shishito peppers. See how this unique high-heat pan will unlock new potential for your grill. Constructed from heat-treated Carbon Steel, our Grill Frying Pan can withstand temperatures up to 1200F. Chefs love it for grilling vegetables, fruit, and wings, or quickly moving ingredients into different heat zones.
